An '''OOM security battle droid''' was stationed on the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]] in the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] at the time of the [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|Battle of Lola Sayu]].

==Biography==
During the imprisonment of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] by the Separatists in the Citadel prison on Lola Sayu, this [[OOM-series security droid/Legends|Security droid]] along with many others were under command of prison warden, [[Phindian/Legends|Phindian]] [[Osi Sobeck/Legends|Osi Sobeck]]. When the elite team of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] led by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] arrived on the planet and infiltrated the detention facility, rescuing the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] master, this [[Droid/Legends|droid]] warned Osi Sobeck that the group was heading for the upper levels of the prison.

==Behind the scenes==
This OOM security battle droid, like every battle droid in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''The Clone Wars'' movie]] and [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series]], was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]]. His name was never given.
